content.short: Reveel is a revenue share protocol with on-chain earnings tools that enables better pay-outs for businesses and creators.
content.description: Reveel is a revenue-sharing protocol with a suite of on-chain earnings tools that helps developers implement payout capabilities for businesses and creators. In collaborations, revenue must be shared among multiple parties, and arrangements can be complex, including recouping advances and milestone-based splits. Reveel provides audited revenue-sharing features to simplify these processes and ensure transparent, verifiable payouts across all participants.
content.meta: Reveel is a revenue share protocol with on-chain earnings tools for developers. Discover Reveel and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
